param_input_item.param_description: a string: when provided, only skills whose triggers or name words match the text are returned.

param_output_item.param_description: a struct array, one entry per skill, with the fields name, description, triggers, path and source.

description.p: nelson.ai.skills returns the assistant skills discovered from three sources, merged by name.

The sources are, in increasing precedence: the built-in catalog shipped with the ai module, a skills folder in any loaded module, and the user folder under the preferences directory. A skill defined in a higher-precedence source overrides a built-in or module skill of the same name.
Each skill is a SKILL.md file; its metadata is read by nelson.ai.parseSkill. The source field of the result reports where the skill was found and is one of builtin, module or user.

When a query string is given, the result keeps only the skills whose declared triggers, or whose name words of four characters or more, appear in the text. This is how the assistant selects the skills relevant to a request.
User skills are installed under the preferences directory and can be managed with nelson.ai.marketplace.install and the related functions.

example_item.example_item_description: Read the name and source of each skill.
Keep only the skills relevant to a request.
example_item.example_item_data: result = nelson.ai.skills('help me write a unit test')
